My name is Irshad Ul Haq and I am a postdoctoral associate at the the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities. My research combines experimental and multi-omic approaches with microbial ecology, physiology, and genetics to understand how fungal decomposition mechanisms shape microbial community assembly, fungal interactions with physiologically distinct bacteria, and carbon cycling in terrestrial environments.
